        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """

    ## Parameters (constants)
    omk_osc_throttle = params[0] # Oscillatory angular frequency
    ks_osc_inertia = params[1]  # Oscillatory inertial constant
    G_scale_constant = float(1.0)  # Gravitational scale factor
